# ComboBox steals a shared Store's record-change notification route

## Context

While exercising the practical Grid/ComboBox workflow for #7224, a source Store stopped publishing record edits after being passed to a ComboBox. The field's filtering remains isolated, but its private view takes the source Model's notification route. This is a follow-up to the shared-store repair in #18839 / PR #18857; its author independently confirmed the source chain.

## The Problem

Reproduced at `80c3f48feb` with real Store/Model/ComboBox instances under `test/playwright/setup.mjs`:

1. Create a Store with a Model and custom `keyProperty: 'code'`; subscribe to `recordChange`.
2. Edit an existing record: the source emits once (control).
3. Create `ComboBox({store, displayField: 'name', valueField: 'code'})`.
4. Edit the existing record, add another record and edit it.
5. Destroy the field and edit the source again.

Observed:
```json
{
  "before": {"events":["control"],"owner":"neo-store-1"},
  "during": {"events":["control"],"owner":"neo-store-2-all","records":2,"view":2},
  "after": {"events":["control"],"owner":"neo-store-2-all","ownerExists":false}
}
```
Record values change, but their source consumers receive no edit notification. Membership propagation still works, so existing count/filter assertions do not detect the defect.

## The Architectural Reality

`ComboBox#afterSetStore` passes `model: value.model` to a new `sourceId` Store. `Store#afterSetModel` assigns that same instance's `storeId`; `RecordFactory#onRecordChange` dispatches through it. A Model has one notification owner.

Design authority: ComboBox's `store_` JSDoc promises that a passed/bound Store stays its owner's; `Store#onRecordChange` and the [Tables guide](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/learn/guides/datahandling/Tables.md) identify the owning Store as the publisher of record changes.

Prescription checked: `src/form/field/ComboBox.mjs#afterSetStore` owns construction of the private picker projection. Repair that consumer; do not redesign general Store ownership.

## The Fix

Give the private view an independent instance of the source Model's class, copying its current fields, keyProperty and trackModifiedFields while preserving calculate/convert functions. The field owns this instance and retires it with the view; the source Model remains untouched. Preserve the original record objects through `sourceId`, filtering isolation, and field-owned teardown.

Omitting `model` alone is insufficient: an Integer business key with `listConfig: {useInternalId: false}` then resolves DOM key `'7'` as a string and misses numeric map key `7`; calculated/nested metadata is also lost. Keep schema behavior without transferring the source's Model instance or `storeId`.

## Contract Ledger

| Surface | Authority | Restored behavior | Fallback / docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Passed/bound Store and Model | ComboBox `store_` JSDoc; Store/RecordFactory routing | Field/view lifecycle never changes the source Model's notification owner | Existing inline/config-created Store ownership stays unchanged; owning method JSDoc | Existing and added record edits before/during/after field lifetime |
| Private picker view | `afterSetStore`, `listStore`, `Store#getKeyType` | Shared records; independent filters and Model state; retained typed-key and schema behavior | No new caller configuration | Numeric business-key, calculated/nested field and swap/multiple-field controls |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Source Model notification ownership remains unchanged when a passed or bound Store is attached, swapped, or the ComboBox is destroyed.
- [ ] Existing and newly added source records emit exactly one source `recordChange` per edit before, during and after field lifetime; source membership still reaches the picker.
- [ ] Numeric business-key lookup with `useInternalId: false`, current calculated/nested schema metadata and Model subclass methods remain correct.
- [ ] Multiple fields and store replacement do not steal each other's routing; inline/config-owned Store teardown and existing typing-filter isolation remain intact. Include the inherited Chip consumer where it shares this path. Every private Model introduced by the repair is destroyed on view replacement or field teardown.
- [ ] Regression cases in `ComboBoxSharedStore.spec.mjs` fail on the current code and pass with the repair; existing ComboBox unit and browser coverage passes.

## Out of Scope

General automatic Model cloning in Store, new sourceId APIs, broad recordChange fan-out to projections, and the #7224 guide itself. Do not fold the separate #2797 animation feature into this repair.

## Avoided Traps

Do not temporarily restore `model.storeId` after constructing the view: multiple consumers would still fight over one routing slot. Do not remove schema metadata merely to preserve notifications, or replace shared records with copied row objects.

## Related

#7224 requires this fix for its edit workflow. Prior repair #18839 / #18857; adjacent #19669 governs filter ownership and excludes general typeahead composition.

Self-owned repair for the currently exercised backlog workflow; Sophie will implement, Ada has offered cross-family review. Contributor-ready labeling is omitted because implementation begins now.
